StudioProject.title: StudioProject
StudioProject.description: A full-stack project in NovaForge AI Studio with multi-language source files and cloud settings.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated project owner.

language.description: Primary stack/language (e.g., Full-Stack Web, Python + FastAPI, Kotlin + Compose, Node.js + SQL).

htmlCode.description: Frontend markup / UI layout source code.

cssCode.description: Stylesheet and theme tokens source code.

backendCode.description: Backend API / server / bioinformatics pipeline source code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when project was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when project was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

VersionSnapshot.title: VersionSnapshot
VersionSnapshot.description: An immutable cloud version control snapshot (commit) of a project's full-stack codebase.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

projectId.description: The ID of the parent StudioProject.

commitMessage.description: Commit message describing the snapshot changes.

addedLines.description: Number of added lines compared to previous version.

deletedLines.description: Number of deleted lines compared to previous version.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when snapshot was committed (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DbCollectionSchema.title: DbCollectionSchema
DbCollectionSchema.description: A user-defined flexible database table/collection schema and JSON dataset managed in the Database Studio.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

projectId.description: The ID of the associated project.

collectionName.description: Name of the collection or table.

fieldsSpec.description: Comma-separated schema definition of fields and types.

sampleRecordsJson.description: Structured records stored in this collection for visual querying.

indexConfig.description: Indexing and security rule configuration notes.

BuildExecutionLog.title: BuildExecutionLog
BuildExecutionLog.description: Real-time code monitoring, build telemetry, and detailed audit report entry.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

projectId.description: The ID of the associated project.

reportSummary.description: Detailed diagnostic report and code telemetry output.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the build execution.

/users/{userId}/snapshots/{snapshotId}.description: Per-user version control snapshots and commit history.

/users/{userId}/collections/{collectionI.description: Per-user flexible database schemas and queryable records.

/users/{userId}/logs/{logId}.description: Per-user real-time build monitoring logs and detailed reports.
